model_annotation: This bar chart, titled “每日新增患者人数与新闻媒体报道数目变化趋势” (Daily New Patient Numbers and News Media Reporting Trends), illustrates the daily trend of new patient cases alongside the corresponding number of news media reports over time, spanning from July 1, 2022, to August 26, 2022. The horizontal axis represents dates, labeled in intervals such as “2022年7月1日” (July 1, 2022) and “2022年8月26日” (August 26, 2022), arranged chronologically from left to right. The vertical axis on the left, labeled “每日新增患者人数” (Daily New Patient Numbers), uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1,800,000, with tick marks at intervals of 200,000. A secondary vertical axis on the right, labeled “新闻媒体每日报道数目” (Daily News Media Reporting Number), uses a linear scale from 0 to 6,000, with tick marks at intervals of 1,000. The chart displays teal-colored bars representing “该日全球确诊数量” (Global Confirmed Cases for that day), with bar heights corresponding to the daily patient numbers, ranging from approximately 200,000 to over 1,600,000; for instance, the bar for July 15, 2022, reaches approximately 1,600,000, while the bar for August 26, 2022, is around 700,000. Superimposed on the bars is a blue line representing “有关covid-19新闻数量” (Number of COVID-19-related news reports), which fluctuates between approximately 0 and 5,000 on the right-hand axis. The bars are not sorted but presented in chronological order, and no bars are visually emphasized or annotated beyond their color coding and the overlaid line.
